The best thing about lavaan is that you can look at the source. See:

https://github.com/yrosseel/lavaan/blob/master/R/lav_fit_measures.R

and look at the lines 777 - 905. You will see that we have three types:
srmr_bollen, srmr_bentler, and srmr_mplus...

Yves.
